newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Analysts see unchanged Danish CPI in Nov.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Analysts see unchanged Danish CPI in Nov.

text.p: Ten Danish analysts polled by Reuters on Wednesday forecast an average unchanged 2.4 percent year-on-year consumer price index rise in November from October, using the national calculation method.
The analysts saw the CPI rising however by 0.2 percent on average on a monthly basis from October to November, compared to 0.1 percent from September to October 1996.
The annual estimates for November's CPI ranged from a low 2.3 percent rise to a high 2.5 percent with the monthly data in the 0.1-0.3 percent range.
The Danish National Statistics Office is to issue its CPI data for November on Thursday December 19 at 0830 gmt.
The forecast data is based on the national not the EU method.
